result.title: GeoJeV: Unified Spatial Probability for Training-Free Efficient Evidence Acquisition in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
result.summary: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing imagery provides rich spatial details but poses challenges for accurate and efficient multimodal understanding. Existing evidence acquisition methods selectively explore relevant image regions, yet largely rely on generative multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for intermediate search control. However, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) primarily aligns these models with human-preferred responses rather than explicitly optimizing region-level relevance judgments, while repeated autoregressive decoding introduces additional computational overhead. To address these limitations, we propose GeoJeV, a training-free method that formulates evidence acquisition as spatial probability-driven decision making. At each evaluated region, a frozen JeV model produces a probability distribution over candidate regions. Specifically, Region Rank prioritizes candidate regions, Sparse Branch adaptively determines branching width through sparse probability support, and Depth Gate controls refinement depth based on branch sparsity and distribution concentration. By coordinating search priority, branching width, and refinement depth through a shared distribution, GeoJeV reduces reliance on RLHF-aligned generation and eliminates intermediate decoding. Experiments on LRS-GRO, MME-RealWorld-RS, and LRS-VQA achieve accuracies of 60.59%, 52.79%, and 34.32%, respectively. Across the three benchmarks, GeoJeV improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B by +5.32pp with only 1.12 additional seconds per question, while achieving a 7.8-fold inference speedup over the recent method.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练方法 GeoJeV，将超高分辨率遥感影像的证据获取建模为空间概率驱动的决策：由冻结的 JeV 模型在每个区域给出候选区域概率分布，用 Region Rank、Sparse Branch 和 Depth Gate 分别控制搜索优先级、分支宽度与细化深度，从而免去 RLHF 生成式中间解码；三个基准上较 Qwen3-VL-8B 平均提升 5.32pp，每题仅增约 1.12 秒，并比近期方法快 7.8 倍。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应 LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本、视觉证据筛选和动态计算，可供核查以区域概率分布驱动分支与停止的可靠性；但它不显式维护 latent 推理状态，也未检验所选证据是否真正影响答案，其内部机制仍需读原文。
